book.title: Na Jon A Lagasai Roxo Na Jon A Xaleie

content: A Mu Sisiak Sina Mu Matalava Juda Ri Pis Na Yesus

Layaan na Yesus a fataxapin a fenungan sina, nane xuvul pana mu fefeng sina ri taꞌulan a lifu aave e ri fe sangas liu a lana mui Kitron. A toxan a nobina ri xapis a wai olif lana e nane xuvul pana mu fefeng sina ri laak pe lana.
Na Judas aava xena pet lisane, a texaas sena nobina aapave senaso na Yesus fuuna waan pave faxaves xuvul pana mu fefeng sina.

Lavaxa, na Judas a savat la nobina aapave xuvul pana mu rabuna ina rawen aava mu matalava Juda ri feng nari e saxanu fefeng sina memai priis e mu Ferasi vaxa. E nari xapiak ri toxan a lamak e laam e maana mo ina fevisan: a tol, vam e pinis.
Na Yesus a texaas sena maana mo aava ri taa savat e a sivi xena fasusui nari e a fin nari, “Mi taxa seng naseꞌ?”
E ri suie, “Na Yesus ti Nasaret.” “Nenia monabeꞌ” na Yesus a xuus nari. E na Judas vaxa aava xena pet lisane, i taxa tigina la palou iri.
E layaan nane kuus malaan, monabeꞌ mon nari xapiak ri poxo suꞌ xe lapia.
E nane fin fulan nari, “Mi taxa seng naseꞌ?” E ri xuus fulane, “Na Yesus ti Nasaret.”
Na Yesus a kuus, “Ne fo xuus nami o nenia monabeꞌ. Lavaxa mi taa pife yot nari xapiak aanabeꞌ senaso mi fo tinginau e nenia va ne saxa aava mi taxa senge.”
Nane kuus malaan xena vil fasavat a ferawaian sina layaan nane fo kuus, “Ne pife taꞌulan tapin a saxa siri aava no fo tavaiau pana.”
Na Saimon Pita a toxan a pinis e nane siaxe e sip a saxa sisiak sina memai priis pana, a isina na Melkas. Nane patal tapin a tangana pamuaan.
Taasaxa na Yesus a baras na Pita, “Timin faꞌuli a pinis siim! No lamon o ne taa pife num ti lana lisa aava na Tamaang fo tavaiau pana?”
Ri Lisan Na Yesus Xe Si Aanas
E nari mu rabuna ina rawen e paamu siri e nari mu fefeng sina mu matalava Juda ri yot na Yesus. E ri pise
e ri lisan paamuiane xe si Aanas. Nane va imu Kaiafas aava paamua priis la mariaas aave.
Na Kaiafas a saxa aava fo fasei a mu Juda o a vilaana roxo tamo a mataa saxa taa maat xana mu rabuna xapiak.
Na Saimon Pita narie xasa fefeng si Yesus re taxa usi nari xuvul pa Yesus. E xasa fefeng xo, fe laak xe lana bina sina memai priis senaso nari pave ri taraxalie.

Taasaxa na Pita pife fexaxaas sena laak e nane waan suꞌ pe lamalei la matana bina aave. E a fefeng aava memai priis a texaas sena, nane ulaa e fe ferawai xuvul pana tefin aava fuuna faxatang a yalaxau aave e xel falak na Pita xe lana.
E a tefin aave a fin na Pita, “Nano, no saxa fefeng sina mataa aapave, bo?” E na Pita a suie, “Au, pife nenia!”
A bina a vutung e mu sisiak e mu fefeng sina mu matalava ri tigina fakaliuan a fata aava ri sunge xena maari. E na Pita sait taxa tigina maari xuvul pari.
A Memai Priis Taxa Fin Na Yesus
La yaan aanabeꞌ a memai priis i taxa fin na Yesus pana mu fefeng sina e sena fepitaian sina.

Na Yesus a suie, “Ne fo ferawai la matavas la matana mu rabuna. Vulai ne fuuna fepitaa lana mu lifu ina faxuvulan o lana tang lifu lotu, a mu bina aava nari mu Juda ri fuuna faxuvul lana. Ne pife kuus fufunai.
Muta finau! Mi fin nari aava ri fo langaiau. Ri texaas faroxo sena ferawaian siak.”
Layaan na Yesus a kuus malaan a saxa paamua aava i taxa tigina faasilak sena a tavafe la yaavana e xuuse, “A pife vilaana roxo ina sui a memai priis ve malaan, bo?”
Na Yesus a xuuse, “Tamo ne fo ferawai fasaat no taa kuusane, tamo ne ferawai fatak sena tuunayan xenaso no fo tavafau?”
E na Aanas a lisan na Yesus aava taxa vipis lunai, xe si Kaiafas, xasa memai priis.
Na Pita A Faaxolusan Na Yesus
Layaan na Saimon Pita taxa maari la xasing ina fata a saxa mataa fulaa a fine, “Nano, no saxa ina mu fefeng sina mataa aapave, bo?” E na Pita a kuus malaan, “Piau! Pife nenia.”
E saxa sisiak sina memai priis, a tauna mataa aava na Pita patal tapin a tangana, a tisui faagutane, “Naak, ne fo xalum nano xuvul pana pave la nobina ina olif?”
E na Pita a faaxolus fulaa e la noyaan aave xa a pura a taliskukuk.
Na Yesus A Tigina Lapaana Tiisan Si Pailat

Lavaxa, la paanen lolof xo a mu Juda ri taꞌulan a lifu si Kaiafas e ri lisan na Yesus xe la lifu sina paamua lava ti Rom. A mu Juda ri bai laak lana lifu la yaan aapave senaso ri lamon tamo ri taa laak a lalosaat sina mu topen i taa waan la tari e ri pife fexaxaas sena fangan la Fenamo ina Paaliuan.
E voxo na Pailat a savat xe siri lamalei e fin nari, “A so ta vilaana mi taxa gel tifi a mataa aanabeꞌ pana?”
“Tamo nane pife mataa saat maam taa pife lisanmaane xe siim” ri suie.
Na Pailat a xuus nari, “Lavaxa, nami fatak, mi xele saa e mi fe tiise lapaana vuputkai simi.” E ri sui fulane, “Taasaxa maam piau ta ngavuk ina punuk a mataa.”
A mo aanabeꞌ a savat talo a ferawaian na Yesus fo xuus nari pana sena so ta buk maatan sina, i taa savat tuuna.
Na Pailat a xel na Yesus e re taꞌulan nari. Re laak lana lifu lava sina e nane fine, “Nano, no piran king sina mu Juda?”
Na Yesus a suie, “A fiaian aave ve siim fatak o xasanofuna ri xuus nano pana?”
Na Pailet a xuuse, “No lamon o nenia, ne mataa ti Judia? A mu rabuna siim e mu memai priis siim ri fo lisanmaan nano e ri nungau o ne taa tiis nano. A so ta mo no fo vile?”

Na Yesus a xuuse, “A fatataganan siak pife waan nabeꞌ la xavala. Tamo i taxa waan nabeꞌ a mu fefeng siak ri taa fevis xena ti votan a mu Juda sena pisaan nenia. Taasaxa fatataganan siak taxa waan pe lana bina patak.”

E voxo na Pailat a fine, “Nano, no saxa piran king, bo?” Na Yesus a suie, “No taxa kuus tuuna layaan no kuus o nenia, ne saxa piran king. A tuuna paaliu a fufuna luluuxan siak e a fufuna savatan siak nabeꞌ la xavala ve xena kuusan fasavat a tuunayan. A maana rabuna xapiak aava ri vubuxan a tuunayan ri taa langaiau.”
Na Pailat a fine, “A tuunayan ve a so ta mo?” E nane savat faꞌulaa xe sina mu matalava Juda, pe lamalei e xuus nari, “Ne pife tingin ta fufuna ferawaian xena tiisaana mataa aanabeꞌ.
Taasaxa mi toxan a saxa vilaana malaan: ne fuuna mulus tapin a saxa mataa vipis la Yaan ina Paaliuan. Mi vubuk o ne taa mulus tapin a piran king sina mu Juda?”
E ri xukulai faagut, “Piau! A mataa aave piau. Maam vubuxan na Baraabas!” Na Baraabas a mataa saat paaliu ina fenauan.
